names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 13719, «Иоанн (Преображенский), протодиакон, сщмч.», with the two rank words after the comma left off. The day’s own line gives the name without the surname — «Сщмч. Иоанна диакона и мч. Андрея (1938).» `fk.mjs` returns no holder for the form and none for the display name. THE BARE «Иоанн» WAS DELIBERATELY NOT STORED: that string heads the largest fold in this corpus.

death.note: The year the day line prints for the entry that names him and Andrew: «Сщмч. Иоанна диакона и мч. Андрея (1938).» No year of birth appears on either of the two pages that name him, and none was inferred.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 мая ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Иоанна диакона и мч. Андрея (1938).»

attestations.note: The day’s eighth entry, and the first of the two people that one line names. THE CALENDAR GIVES NO LIFE: the line carries a link to his name and none to a reading, and the name page behind it, 13719, prints the title and the line «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 29 мая» and nothing else at all. What it gives that the day line does not is the surname «Преображенский» and the grade «протодиакон», protodeacon, where the day line says «диакона»; `office` is the name page’s own word, which seven folders already use and the four locale packs carry, and `deacon` is in `types` off the day line. `new-martyr` WAS WRITTEN AND THE GROUND IS READ: his page carries the 26 января synaxis of the new martyrs beside his own day, and the line calls him a martyr. NO `related` ROW WAS WRITTEN TO THE ANDREW OF THE SAME LINE: the line names the two of them with one year and gives no «with him», no place and no narrative, and a shared line is not a relation any more than a shared year is. The pair is reported to the author. NO FOLDER WAS FOUND FOR HIM. The day page prints eleven hymns and none under his name. azbyka.ru was not read.
